title: Vasaloppet Endurance Base: Low-Intensity Cardio & Aerobic Capacity

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and deliberately, focusing on spinal mobility. Coordinate breathing with movement: inhale on extension, exhale on flexion.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Maintain upright posture, keep hips level. Switch legs smoothly without compensating at the lower back. This mobilizes hip external rotation needed for skiing.

items.name: Band Pullaparts
items.cues: Keep arms at shoulder height, slight bend in elbows. Pull band apart with controlled movement, squeezing shoulder blades together at the end. This activates posterior chain for skiing posture.

items.name: Air Bike
items.cues: Easy pace, focus on finding your rhythm. This is activation, not intensity. Maintain steady breathing and get the body warm for the main session.

items.name: Rowing Machine
items.cues: Maintain RPE 5-6 (conversational pace). Sustainable effort where you can speak in short sentences. Focus on smooth, rhythmic strokes: legs drive first, then core, then arms pull. This mimics the lower-intensity cardio needed for Vasaloppet endurance base.

items.name: Ski Erg
items.cues: Sport-specific skiing movement at easy RPE 5-6. Focus on maintaining steady power output with full range of motion. Keep shoulders relaxed, engage core, and let the arms drive the movement naturally. This builds event-specific aerobic capacity.

items.name: Air Bike
items.cues: Easy transition piece to finish the main work. Stay at RPE 5-6, light and controlled. Use this to accumulate low-intensity volume and practice steady-state effort.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Gentle, slow movements to reduce heart rate and restore mobility. Focus on gentle spinal articulation.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Hold each side for 30 seconds, lean gently into the stretch. Focus on opening up the chest and anterior shoulder.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold 30 seconds each leg. Keep heel planted, lean forward gently. Important for recovery after rowing and skiing work.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Slow, controlled movement. Extend opposite arm and leg fully, pause briefly, return. This promotes core stability and spinal neutrality after endurance work.

rationale: This endurance workout focuses on low-intensity, high-duration cardio (RPE 5-6) which is essential for building aerobic base 7 weeks out from Vasaloppet 90km. Pure endurance racing requires significant time in zone 2.

The combination of rowing machine, ski erg, and air bike provides sport-specific training (ski erg) plus cross-training benefits. This mirrors the previous session's structure while building aerobic capacity through steady-state work.

Total cardio volume is 43 minutes of continuous/near-continuous low-intensity work, fitting the 50-minute target window. This session matches the user's stated status of 'great' and follows appropriate progression after the 55-minute endurance session from 6 days prior.
